CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 43
   C. 41
   D. 31

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 25

3. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 4

4. Solve for x: x + 9 = 20. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 20
   C. 11
   D. 12

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

7. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

8. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 2
   C. 10
   D. 25

9. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

11. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 1
   D. 12

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — 41
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 40²
3. c² = 81 + 1600
4. c² = 1681
5. c = 41
Final Answer: 41 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

2. D — 25
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 5² = 5 × 5
3. 5² = 25
Final Answer: 25
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. B — 32
Working:

2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 8
3. Product = 32
Final Answer: 32
